integrity: The source generators are reconstructed over F4, all cyclic shifts are row-reduced, and the Hermitian dual is obtained by conjugating the ordinary nullspace. A standalone verifier exhausts all 4^7 dual words and all minimum supports, checks the Gram-rank hull computation, and checks all orbit and block-pattern counts.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to the exact Example 8 generator. It does not classify all optimal quaternary [21,7,11]_4 codes. The source already establishes the parameters and optimality; the new content is the exact spectrum, Hermitian hull, and minimum-support geometry.
title: Exact spectrum and minimum-support geometry of Example 8's Hermitian dual
